title: Cisco LR-888 Switched AC Adapter PN 37-1070-01 – 250 V 10 A C13/C14 Power Module

items.h: Switchable module – allows power control at the adapter level.

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Cisco LR-888 Switched AC Adapter (Part Number 37-1070-01) is designed for professional IT infrastructure setups. This adapter module features a built-in switch and IEC-type C13/C14 connectivity, enabling controlled power to networking devices, servers, or rack setups. 


Key Features:


  • Model: LR-888 (PN 37-1070-01)
  • Rated: 250 V AC, 10 A current. 
  • Plug/Connector types: C13 / C14 (IEC standard)
  • Switchable module – allows power control at the adapter level. 

Benefits:


  • Official Cisco-compatible accessory ensures reliable performance in Cisco environments.
  • Simplifies power management in server racks or network cabinets thanks to the built-in switch.
  • Meets high standards for voltage and current, suitable for typical data-centre applications.
  • Helps maintain neat and controlled power wiring with a known part number for service/maintenance.
